This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the time when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy|galaxy]]. When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was executed by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], she was with two other padawans that were able to escape the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|destruction]] caused by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. While attempting to escape [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], she and her companions were crossing the [[Shinarcan Bridge Extension]], but their chances to flee proved futile as they were suddenly caught by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] personnel, leading to a terrible shootout.
